request: Pull a live snapshot of all aircraft state vectors over the contiguous United States (lat 24-49.5, lon -125 to -66) from the OpenSky Network public API. Each row = one aircraft instance with position, velocity, heading, altitude, ground/airborne state. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 08 - Live US Air Traffic' on Tableau Server for transportation analysts to monitor airspace utilization in real time.

sources.name: OpenSky US Live Air Traffic
sources.description: OpenSky Network /api/states/all endpoint, bbox-filtered to the contiguous US (lamin=24, lamax=49.5, lomin=-125, lomax=-66). Each row = one aircraft state vector at the snapshot time. Public, keyless. Snapshot-only (no time series); refresh every 5 minutes via Prep schedule.

outputs.name: OpenSky US Live States
outputs.description: Live snapshot of aircraft state vectors over the contiguous U.S. from OpenSky Network. One row per aircraft observed at snapshot time. Includes ICAO 24-bit address (icao24), callsign, registered origin_country, last position/contact timestamps (epoch seconds), longitude, latitude, baro_altitude (meters), on_ground (boolean), velocity (m/s), true_track (degrees, 0=N), vertical_rate (m/s), geo_altitude, squawk code, spi (special purpose indicator), position_source (0=ADS-B, 1=ASTERIX, 2=MLAT, 3=FLARM). Source: OpenSky Network (opensky-network.org). Refresh: 5 minutes.
